diagnostic_steps.action: Parse log stream for network policy events
findings: Network policy 'deny-all-egress' applied to microservices namespace
98% of connections blocked in microservices namespace
External API calls blocked by network policy
No allow rules for inter-service communication
No allow rules for external DNS resolution
Policy was likely applied by mistake or misconfiguration
Service-a needs to communicate with service-b (port 8080)
Service-b needs to access external API (https://api.external.com)
All services need DNS resolution (CoreDNS on UDP 53)
Root cause: Overly restrictive network policy 'deny-all-egress'
Policy was applied without necessary allow rules
No gradual rollout or testing of network policy changes
Lack of network policy validation before application
diagnostic_steps.root_cause: Misconfigured network policy blocking all egress traffic

recommendations.command:
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-microservices-traffic
  namespace: microservices
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  - Egress
  ingress:
  - from:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          name: microservices
  egress:
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          name: microservices
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          name: kube-system
    ports:
    - protocol: UDP
      port: 53
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 0.0.0.0/0
        except:
        - 10.0.0.0/8
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 443
EOF
recommendations.rationale: Apply permissive network policy allowing internal and necessary external traffic

recommendations.command:
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-database-access
  namespace: microservices
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: service-b
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          name: database
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 5432
EOF

kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: microservices
  labels:
    name: microservices
EOF
recommendations.rationale: Ensure namespace labels are correct for policy matching

recommendations.command: kubectl get networkpolicy -n microservices -o yaml > network-policy-backup.yaml
